newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Russian Patriarch taken ill during Vienna mass.
newsitem.headline: Russian Patriarch taken ill during Vienna mass.

text.p: Russian Patriarch Alexiy II was taken ill on Sunday during mass at Vienna's Russian Orthodox cathedral, but recovered soon after with the aid of doctors, state television said.
The Patriarch, who is on a five-day visit to Austria, suffered circulation problems towards the end of the three-hour service, it said.
No one was available for comment at the Russian embassy, where the Patriarch was taken after falling ill.
Patriarch Alexiy will continue his programme as planned, state television said. He is due to attend a service in Vienna's historic St Stephen's cathedral on Sunday evening.
The Patriarch is in Austria to attend the Second Ecumenical Conference which begins on Monday in Graz, southern Austria.
